mappings.rationale: Plan TASK:CORE:C02:003 is tenant-scoped authorization. Active account access is only an identity prerequisite; backend/app/operations/authorization.py authorizes maintenance roles and is not semantically the target authorization system.

mappings.mapped_scope: The current account-authentication boundary supplies an authenticated account identity/session.
mappings.unmapped_scope: No current code node establishes tenant membership, organization role, wallet/resource scoping, employee grants/limits, or customer authorization matrix. OperationsAuthorizer was removed because its data-editor/admin roles are operational, not wallet-member roles.

mappings.rationale: The Plan asks to inspect existing account guards while separately assessing org/personal wallet object paths. The current account access nodes support only the former; no operations-role node is used as a wallet authorization counterpart.

mappings.unmapped_scope: Wallet/object lookup and tenant/role/action guards described by this subtask are not present in these endpoints.
